[color=#00ff00]CONTENT PATCHER VERSION[/color] [/size][/b][/size][/size][size=2][b]
(removed download of xml version as not updating anymore as edits main game files and this is better if want to change/remove can without having to copy over files into contents or backing up contents folder, also packing and unpacking the files created more bugs then anything so CP is better and will be updated to 1.6.14 (steam version time of this update nov 16th))[/b][/size][size=3][size=3][b][size=4]
[/size][/b][b][size=4]

[size=3][size=3][b][size=4][color=#ffff00]1.6.1 Medium dirt all grass types Uploaded[/color][/size][/b][/size][/size]
[/color][/size][color=#ffff00]Working on Dark dirt then a lighter light dirt[/color][size=4]

[color=#ff0000]For update info check the first sticky post for changes and other info on what I'm working on and current news of mods process 
[/color][/size][/b][/size][/size]
[size=3]Following language support is included: [color=#ff7700]English[/color], [color=#ffff00]German[/color], [color=#ff7700]Spanish[/color], [color=#ffff00]Brazilian Portuguese[/color], [color=#ff7700]Russian[/color], [color=#ffff00]Japanese[/color] and[color=#ff7700] Simplified Chinese [/color](note unsure if any English parts on other languages tested before 1.6)
[/size]3 Dirt types Light, Medium, and Dark. Along with 4 grass types Original, Grass 1, Grass 2, and Grass 3

[color=#00ff00][size=4]How to Install:[/size][/color]
[size=3](I) Download SMPAI and install
(II) Download Content Patcher and install

(1) Download this mod
(2) Open zip file
(3) Open the [color=#00ffff]Light Dirt, Medium Dirt [/color]or[color=#00ffff] Dark Dirt[/color] folder ﻿(included encase i make all 3 dirt's in one)
(plans to add a [color=#00ffff]Better Dirt[/color] option where dirt is lighter then light dirt and less brown)
(4) Pick a grass type and drag or copy and paste into mods folder ﻿ (don't open the file like before)
(5) Start up the game and should see in-game the changes
[/size]
To delete:
(1) Delete the file from mods
(2) done its gone start up and play

[color=#00ffff]If you use other content packs like worm replacement let me know if they work for you as this loads the whole file so covers everything (NEW LAYOUT DOES NOT) cursor file is now only the effected areas[/color]
